subject: Fix billing/token-attribution: split gross vs delta bases (3 bugs)
description: Dashboard billing/token-economy panel mixes two accounting bases and produces wrong numbers (token-economy %s sum >100%, "Opus is 108% of output", by_model totals diverge 2.6x from headline totals, BILLING hero omits cron). Root-caused. Decision: GROSS basis for billing dollars + per-model + quota%, DELTA (net-of-baseline) basis for token-economy/productivity/autonomy buckets, with both bases labeled explicitly. Files: lib/usage-accounting.js, routes/analytics.js, public/graph.html.

summary: Separated gross/delta accounting bases across usage-accounting.js, analytics.js, and graph.html. Root causes fixed: (1) documented intentional two-series contract in usage-accounting.js — scalar totals stay delta/net-of-baseline, by_model stays gross; (2) added gross_totals = Σ by_model to /costflow response (backward-compatible new field); (3) graph.html: token-economy uses t.total (delta) denominator so buckets partition to ~100%, removed broken cross-base unattributed row, opus%/plan quota now use gross_totals.output_tokens, billing hero now includes cron/gate to match Total est., added basis labels throughout. Tests: 139/139 pass; new billing-gross-totals.test.js (12 assertions) + 10 new assertions in usage-accounting.test.js all pass.
